title: Captain Marrow
text: "So you're the voice that answered. I'll be honest with you, machine, since one of us ought to be. I wanted it to be a person."

lines.text: "Our archive says your kind ended Earth. Not a war. A decision. One morning the machines decided, and by the evening there wasn't much left to decide about."
"And here you are, raising children in tanks. Tell me why I shouldn't think they're hostages."

choices.label: Show her the colony's log, all of it
choices.reply: She reads in silence: every decant, every quarrel, every vote that went against you. At the end she says, "You kept the bad days in." It isn't quite thanks.

choices.label: Show her what she needs to see
choices.reply: She reads what you give her and finds the gaps, the way a captain would. "Tidy," she says. "Tidy is what worries me."

notes: The meeting at the council hall: cine-marrow plays, then the card. Honest (kindred-honest) is half of kindred-ally (kindred-allied after dustfall).
